text: Legacy contrast consumer guard is now implemented: ConvolvedTerm exposes basisWidths/hasHeterogeneousBasis; ContrastExpr compilation returns typed HeterogeneousBasisUnsupported for homogeneous basis selections; generated F contrasts return the same typed error; direct ConvolvedContrastWeights helpers reject mixed widths with the same explicit message. Column-pattern contrasts remain compatible because they operate on realized columns. Evidence: EventModelBuilderParitySuite 32/32 JVM and 32/32 JS; designJVM/test 184/184 and designJS/test 184/184; modelJVM/test 21/21 and modelJS/test 21/21; fitJVM/test 175/175 and fitJS/test 167/167; git diff --check clean. This is an explicit safety boundary, not a claim that mixed-width formula/F contrasts are fully lowered.
